ruleDefinitions.name: NTDS.DIT Creation By Uncommon Parent Process
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects creation of a file named "ntds.dit" (Active Directory Database) by an uncommon parent process or directory

sequences.query: file_path = RGX("\\\\ntds\\\.dit$") AND ((parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\cscript\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\httpd\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\nginx\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\php\\-cgi\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\powershell\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\pwsh\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\w3wp\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\wscript\\\.exe$")) OR (parent_process_path = RGX(".*\\\\apache.*") OR parent_process_path = RGX(".*\\\\tomcat.*") OR parent_process_path = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\.*") OR parent_process_path = RGX(".*\\\\Temp\\\\.*") OR parent_process_path = RGX(".*\\\\Public\\\\.*") OR parent_process_path = RGX(".*\\\\PerfLogs\\\\.*")))
